author: KEXP
description: Los Angeles artist Kevin Litrow has carved a path crafting his own distinctive brand of futuristic synth pop under the musical project Litronix. Our latest in-studio session invites him in to share a performance of "Electric Panoramic" and more.
title: Litronix performs "Electric Panoramic" and more Live on KEXP
